headline: Mercosur-Singapore Free Trade Agreement Enters Into Force
summary: The Mercosur-Singapore Free Trade Agreement has entered into force, eliminating import tariffs on 96% of products for up to 15 years as Singapore and Argentina deepen trade ties.
why: Free trade agreements reduce barriers, lower costs for importers and exporters, and stimulate bilateral commerce between participating economic blocs.

impacts.name: Singapore
impacts.why: Tariff elimination boosts bilateral trade volumes for Singapore.
